page_title: MNT 0-2 LEN | Montpellier v Lens 31/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Bastien Dechepy is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdulay Juma Bah (Lens) replacing Jonathan Gradit.
90+4' Will Still has decided to substitute M'Bala Nzola and he is replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
90+3' Substitution. Adrien Thomasson walks off the pitch and Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) comes on as a substitute.

90+2' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Benjamin Lecomte, who tips the ball around the post.
90+1' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Montpellier are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
87' Deiver Machado (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
86' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier). Bastien Dechepy saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
84' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Teji Savanier (Montpellier) took the corner.
83' The current number of corner kicks is 3:5.
81' Substitution. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) has come on for Enzo Tchato.
81' Mathew Ryan leaps to intercept the corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier).
80' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Montpellier.
79' Will Still has decided to make a change. Angelo Fulgini (Lens) replaces Andy Diouf.
78' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
76' Montpellier fail to score from a corner as Mathew Ryan (Lens) leaps to collect the ball.
76' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Montpellier.
74' Montpellier are seeing far more of the ball now.
72' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.
71' Facundo Medina (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
69' It will be a substitution. Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is ready to enter the pitch as Khalil Fayad walks off.

69' Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
67' Wasted effort! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
66' Lens hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Theo Sainte-Luce as he is replaced by Othmane Maamma (Montpellier).
64' Jean-Louis Gasset is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) suffers an injury and Yael Mouanga comes on.
64' Jean-Louis Gasset prepares a substitution. Andy Delort is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
61' 0 - 2 Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) latches on to a lovely pass and buries the ball into the middle of the goal.
60' Substitution. Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) in, Goduine Koyalipou out.
59' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

58' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
56' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
54' The percentage of ball possession is – 44:56.
52' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
48' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the right post.
46' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Facundo Medina (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
45+6' Deiver Machado (Lens) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45+4' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
45+2' A goal, which was scored by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier), was disallowed due to offside.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' Andy Delort (Montpellier) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
41' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:4.
39' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
37' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:9.

35' Facundo Medina (Lens) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Benjamin Lecomte makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
34' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner but it's cleared.
34' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Lens will have an opportunity.
31' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:7.
27' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to a foul in the build-up play.
26' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Will Still, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
26' Jean-Louis Gasset is stunned as referee Bastien Dechepy shows him a RED CARD.
26' Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
25' Goal! Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
23' The players claim that Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
22' Facundo Medina (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.
19' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
18' Yellow card. Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
17' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Ball possession – 44:56.

13' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a decent low strike towards the middle of the goal, but Benjamin Lecomte denies him with a great save.
12' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle after Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Lens are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

11' Andy Delort (Montpellier) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
10' Referee Bastien Dechepy sees the trip by Deiver Machado (Lens) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
9' Andy Diouf (Lens) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
8' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andy Diouf (Lens). Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
6' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) watches the corner all the way, but places his header just over the bar from close range.
5' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is about to take a corner kick.
3' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball.
1' 0 - 1 M'Bala Nzola (Lens) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Bastien Dechepy.
